用力捏他的脸颊，使劲一扭！
“啊！”杜天海立刻大叫一声，拉下她的手。“你在干么？嫌你老公长得太帅，要把我毁容啊？”他抚着发疼的两颊，觉得妻子真残忍，这不是他想像中的感人重逢啦！
“只是想确定一下你是真的。”她没多想，老实地说。乍见他的时候，还以为自己又作梦了，所以才捏他一下，确认真假。
不过没想到，他那么厚的脸皮也会痛哦……
“怎么，你因为太想我，连作梦也梦到我了吗？”他笑嘻嘻地看着她，脸都不疼了。
被料中事实，她有些心虚地别开眼。
“对，因为梦到你回来，所以被吓醒了。”她冷冷地说，一脸作了恶梦的表情。
实际上，那场春梦对她来说也的确是场可怕的恶梦没错。
“没关系，吓醒了更好，醒着才能好好跟我聊聊天。”他暖味地笑着，眼神也邪恶地盯着她只围着浴巾的身体打量……
就是这种眼神！在梦里他就是用这种邪气的眼神看着她，害她浑身发热。
“去洗个澡准备睡觉吧。”她按撩心底的惊慌，面无表情地说道，自己却急着转身到更衣室里去找衣服穿。
不过她的脚都还没踏进更衣室，人已经被他一把抱住。
“老婆，你太过分了。”他的下巴靠在她的香肩上。
“什……什么？”她全身紧绷地问。
“看你穿成这样，你觉得我还睡得着吗？”他用很可怜的口吻抱怨她的残忍。
穿……她什么都还没穿好不好！
“放开，我困了。”她冷漠地命令他松手，感觉他的体温熨贴着她的背，让她很不自在。
“那就一起睡吧。”他配合度很高的，高挺的鼻尖在她颈边磨蹭，汲取她身上的芬芳，很乐意和她一起躺到床上去。
“杜天海。”她试图拉开他的手，警告他别乱来，她可不想让“恶梦”成真。
但他却一如往常地反叛，不曾顺过她的意，反而将她抱得更紧。

“我们真是心有灵犀呢，老婆。”他吻着她不停闪避的脸颊，满意地微笑，觉得妻子真的是跟他心灵相通的好伴侣。
“有吗？”她心里只有疑问，没有灵犀，不懂他这是什么意思。
“我好想你……这几天一直好想像这样抱你、亲你、闻你……现在一进门，你就帮我实现了……”他舒服地赖在她身上，几天来一直幻想着能抱抱她的香肌玉体、亲亲她滴粉搓酥的脸颊、闻闻她身上淡雅的沐浴乳香味……结果一进房就看见她从浴室里走出来，全身上下只围着一条浴巾，身上散发着迷人的热度和香气。
这还不是心有灵犀加上善解人意吗？
“那你现在可以放手了吧。”她的声音依然清冷，希望能赶快摆脱他的环抱，不想承认当他又说想她的时候，她心底也有份思念在回应着。
是的，这几天里她的确也想念着这个男人，可是她并不想让这份牵挂继续延伸下去，只想冻结自己对他的心。

“我说过我们没什么好聊的，走开……”她拉住他的手，护住身上的浴巾，开始在他怀里挣扎脱困。
而他也不急着阻止她的推拒，只是以不多不少刚好可以将她留在怀中的力道跟她周旋，眸中的瞳色愈来愈深……
“我也说过……你乱动只会让我兴奋吧。”他声音里有丝压抑，下腹亢奋地抵向她俏臀，让她察觉他的欲望。
她是唯一一个总爱在他怀中挣扎，想要逃脱他的女人，可是这反抗举动却只让他更想抱紧她，让她成为他的人，永远留在他身边。
她愣了一下，确实感觉到身后有个硬物抵着她，但……
不管了！现在束手就擒，难道真的要爬上他的床，任他予取予求，让错误的那夜重演一次吗？
不可以，她不想再和这男人产生更深的牵扯，一直和他纠缠不清了。
于是她更奋力地挣扎，抓着胸口的浴巾死命地扭动，甚至不惜踩了他好几脚，还往他的手臂咬了一口——终于挣脱他的牵制，直冲向更衣室里，关上门——
一只脚卡在门缝，挡住她关门的动作！
她使劲全力地一推，想把他的脚逼出门外，才好关门上锁。
“啊——痛……我的骨头……”他发出一串惨叫，半张俊脸在门缝外痛苦地扭曲，看起来痛不欲生。
她吓得松开手，没料到自己下手这么重，把他伤成这样……
“对不起，真的很痛吗？”见他捂着脸，倚在门边痛得说不出话，她急急蹲下检查他的伤势究竟有多严重。

他移开蒙着脸的手，嘴边勾起一道狡猾的弧度，弯腰抱住这个充满爱心的小女人——
“逮到你了。”他贴在她耳边得意地宣布诡计得逞，对怀中失而复得的猎物感到更加兴奋无比。
她惊觉自己上当了，又惊又怒地捶打他。
“你真卑鄙！”居然敢利用她的同情心，真的太无耻了！
“哈哈……我这叫以智取胜。”他像个恶棍似地大笑，没很在意她像按摩似的攻击和咒骂，沿途稳稳当当的将她抱向大床，不让她有机会溜掉第二次。
房内的温度随着男与女的激情一并升高，不停回响着让人脸红的喘息，暖昧的室温一直延续了许久都没散去……

然而抽光了欲望，她的心就像被欲火烧灼过似的，留下剧烈疼痛的灼痕，涨满怅然若失的空虚与凄冷。
在寂静的空气中，她不禁懊悔起自己的软弱无用，竟然又再一次为这个男人牵动心神，交付了自己的身体与灵魂，在被他拥抱的快乐中，无法自欺地察觉到自己其实还是深爱着他……
“我没弄痛你吧？”他温柔地亲吻她的后颈，心想这回自己应该不会再像喝醉酒那样粗鲁地弄疼了她。虽然连番的激情可能会害她太累，但谁让她看起来这么可口诱人，害他实在忍不住多爱她一点。
被他这么一问，佟映晨更是悲从中来，忍不住双肩微颤，再次失去自己不再为他掉一滴泪的决心，潸然泪下。
没错，他是弄痛了她，真的害她的心很痛很痛……又悔又伤……
听见她低咽轻啜，杜天海先是怀疑地一愣，连忙扳过她的身子。
“你怎么哭了？”他讶然地问道，发现她真的在哭，脸上布满泪痕。
“你还敢问！”她推开他，迅速坐起身，气不过地拿起枕头打他。

“可恶的家伙，为什么要这样折磨我……你又不爱我，干么一直缠着我不放，跟我上床，害我过得那么痛苦……可恶，你为什么要让我爱上你，混蛋……”她豁出去似地泣诉他的残忍，事到如今也无暇顾及他知不知道自己的真心了，她只想发泄地大骂他一顿，指控他恶意扣住她的心，每靠近一步，便让她觉得愈来愈难离开他，觉得即使把钱还清了，她也赎不回完整的感情。

看着她哭得泪流满面，他既心疼又惊讶，不过听到那句“我爱上你”——尽管现在笑出来可能不太合宜，但他的唇角就是忍不住抽呀抽的，往两头弯了上去……
“你……说你爱我？”他喜出望外地看着她，再确认一次，怕自己笑错场子。

Pinch his cheeks hard and twist them hard!
"Ah!" Du Tianhai immediately shouted and pulled her hand down. "What are you doing? You think your husband is too handsome and you want to disfigure me?" He stroked his sore cheeks and felt that his wife was really cruel. This was not the touching reunion he had imagined!
"I just want to make sure you are real." She said honestly without thinking too much. When I first saw him, I thought I was dreaming again, so I pinched him to confirm whether it was true or not.
But I didn’t expect that his thick skin would hurt...
"Why, you miss me so much that you even dream about me?" He looked at her with a smile, his face no longer hurt.
After being told the truth, she looked away with some guilt.
"Yes, I woke up because I dreamed about you coming back." She said coldly, looking like she was having a nightmare.
In fact, that erotic dream was indeed a terrible nightmare for her.
"It doesn't matter. It's better if you wake up with a fright. Only when you are awake can you have a good chat with me." He smiled warmly and stared evilly at her body, which was only wrapped in a bath towel...
That's the look! In the dream, he looked at her with such evil eyes, which made her whole body feel hot.
"Go take a shower and get ready for bed." She suppressed the panic in her heart and said expressionlessly, but she hurriedly turned around and went to the dressing room to find clothes to wear.
But before she even set foot in the dressing room, she was already hugged by him.
"Honey, you've gone too far." His chin rested on her shoulder.
"Wha...what?" she asked with her whole body tense.
"Looking at you dressed like this, do you think I can still sleep?" He complained about her cruelty in a pitiful tone.
Wear...she hasn't put on anything yet, okay?
"Let go, I'm sleepy." She ordered him coldly to let go, feeling his body temperature pressing against her back, which made her very uncomfortable.
"Then let's sleep together." He was very cooperative, rubbing his high nose against her neck, absorbing the fragrance from her body, and was happy to lie on the bed with her.
"Du Tianhai." She tried to pull away his hand and warned him not to mess around. She didn't want the "nightmare" to come true.
But he was rebellious as usual, and instead of complying with her wishes, he hugged her tighter.
"We really have a good connection, wife." He kissed her cheek, which she kept avoiding, and smiled with satisfaction, feeling that his wife was really a good companion who was connected to him.
"Is there any?" She only had doubts in her mind, not a clear understanding of what he meant.
"I miss you so much... I have always wanted to hold you, kiss you, and smell you like this these past few days... Now as soon as I walked in, you helped me realize it..." He leaned on her comfortably. For several days, he had been fantasizing about hugging her fragrant body, kissing her powdered cheeks, and smelling the elegant fragrance of her body lotion... As soon as he entered the room, he saw her walking out of the bathroom, wearing only a bath towel, exuding charming heat and fragrance.
Isn’t this not understanding and understanding?
"Then you can let go now." Her voice was still cold, hoping to get rid of his embrace as soon as possible. She didn't want to admit that when he said he missed her again, she also felt longing for him in her heart.
Yes, she did miss this man in the past few days, but she didn't want this concern to continue to extend, she just wanted to freeze her heart for him.

"I said we have nothing to talk about, go away..." She took his hand, protected the bath towel on her body, and began to struggle out of his arms.
And he was not in a hurry to stop her rejection. He just dealt with her with just enough force to keep her in his arms, and the color in his eyes became darker and darker...
"I also said... your movements will only excite me." There was a hint of suppression in his voice, and his lower abdomen excitedly pressed against her pretty buttocks, making her aware of his desire.She was the only woman who always loved to struggle in his arms, trying to escape from him, but this act of resistance only made him want to hold her tighter, make her his and stay by his side forever.
She was stunned for a moment, and she did feel a hard object pressing against her behind her, but...
No matter! Now that you are at a loss, do you really want to climb into his bed, let him have whatever he wants, and let the wrong night happen again?
No, she didn't want to get more involved with this man and get entangled with him all the time.
So she struggled even harder, grabbing the towel on her chest and twisting desperately. She even stepped on him several times and bit his arm. Finally, she broke free from his grasp, rushed straight to the dressing room, and closed the door.
One foot was stuck in the crack of the door, blocking her from closing the door!
She pushed with all her strength, trying to force his feet out of the door so she could close the door and lock it.
"Ah - it hurts... my bones..." He let out a series of screams, half of his handsome face twisted in pain outside the crack of the door, looking like he was in pain.
She was so frightened that she let go of her hand. She didn't expect that she would hit him so hard and hurt him like this...
"I'm sorry, does it really hurt?" Seeing him covering his face and leaning against the door, speechless in pain, she hurriedly squatted down to check how serious his injury was.
He removed his face-covering hand, curved his mouth in a sly arc, and bent down to hug this loving little woman——
"I caught you." He proudly announced in her ear that the trick had succeeded, and he was even more excited about the lost prey in his arms.
She was shocked to realize that she had been fooled, and beat him with shock and anger.
"You are so despicable!" How dare you take advantage of her sympathy, how shameless!
"Haha... I call it outwitness." He laughed like a villain, not paying much attention to her massage-like attacks and curses. He carried her steadily to the big bed along the way, not letting her have a chance to slip away a second time.
The temperature in the room increased with the passion between the man and the woman, and there was a constant echo of blushing gasps. The warm room temperature continued for a long time and did not dissipate...

In the silent air, she couldn't help but regret her own weakness and uselessness. She once again touched her heart for this man and gave up her body and soul. In the joy of being embraced by him, she couldn't help but realize that she still loved him deeply...
"I didn't hurt you, did I?" He kissed the back of her neck gently, thinking that this time he would not hurt her as roughly as he did when he was drunk. Although the continuous passion may make her too tired, who makes her look so delicious and alluring, he can't help but love her more.
When he asked this question, Tong Yingchen felt even more sad. He couldn't help but his shoulders trembled slightly. He once again lost his determination not to shed a tear for him and burst into tears.
Yes, he hurt her, it really made her heart hurt... she felt regretful and hurt...
Hearing her slurping softly, Du Tianhai was suspicious for a moment, then quickly pulled her over.
"Why are you crying?" he asked in surprise, finding that she was really crying, her face covered with tears.
"How dare you ask!" She pushed him away, sat up quickly, and angrily picked up a pillow and hit him.
